name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
title: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd - 543384 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Nykaa Q1 FY27 shows broad demand acceleration (GMV +34%, EBITDA +68%) with capital-light, asset-light model; supply-side signals are limited to capital discipline and modest store expansion, with no capacity-cycle evidence.

summary.headline: Nykaa Q1 FY27: net revenue up 29% YoY to INR 2,782 crore, EBITDA up 68% to INR 236 crore at 8.5% margin, PAT INR 80 crore.
summary.overview: Nykaa reported GMV of INR 5,590 crore (+34% YoY) and net revenue of INR 2,782 crore (+29% YoY) for Q1 FY27, with gross margin up 123 bps to 45.9%. EBITDA rose 68% to INR 236 crore (8.5% margin, up about 196 bps YoY) and PAT reached INR 80 crore (2.9% margin). Beauty NSV grew 29% with a 10.3% EBITDA margin, while Fashion NSV grew 54% and turned breakeven at the EBITDA level (0.1% margin) with the business profitable overall. Management also announced the acquisition of a 51% stake in dermocosmetic brand Aminu, with the balance to follow over several years.

financial_highlights.change: Profitable overall; 627 bps YoY improvement in profitability

segments.name: Beauty (incl. Nykaa Online, retail, House of Nykaa)
segments.commentary: NSV INR 2,371 crore (+29% YoY) with EBITDA INR 244 crore at 10.3% margin. Transacting customers crossed 20 million annually and AOV rose about 5% in aggregate.

segments.name: Fashion
segments.commentary: NSV INR 451 crore (+54% YoY); women's +40%, men's +83%, kids ~+57-60%. Marketing and S&D expense fell 534 bps to 22.9% of revenue and overheads fell 292 bps; business profitable overall.

segments.name: House of Nykaa
segments.commentary: Annualised GMV INR 3,760 crore (+39% YoY) and annualised NSV about INR 2,200 crore (+36%). The 7 beauty brands delivered Q1 NSV of INR 508 crore (+40%); Dot & Key runs at about INR 1,300 crore annualised NSV, Kay Beauty INR 300 crore and Nykaa Cosmetics INR 270 crore.

segments.name: Nykaa Superstore (B2B)
segments.commentary: NSV grew 28% with GMV slightly lower due to GST-led MRP impact. EBITDA improved by more than 300 bps, with 0.5 million retailers and 240+ brands (18 added in the quarter).

segments.name: Nykaa Retail (stores)
segments.commentary: 324 stores across 100+ cities after 11 openings in Q1, with double-digit same-store sales growth; 50% of stores are in Tier 2 and beyond.

guidance_outlook: Nykaa Now (quick commerce, 60-minute delivery) to expand from 13 cities to over 25 cities by end FY27.
Superstore: GST-led GMV gap expected to normalise from Q3 FY27 so NSV and GMV growth converge; management still targets a 35%+ GMV CAGR, reached by FY2030.
Fashion: Investor Day guidance of 3-3.5x growth over 4-5 years retained, with management saying the core platform could outperform it.
Festive demand expected to fall mainly in Q3 FY27 this year, with some possible spill into Q4.
Aminu acquisition: 51% acquired now; the remaining 49% to be acquired over the next few years under agreed terms.
capex_capacity: Opened the largest Nykaa store at Ambience Vasant Kunj, Delhi (over 5,000 sq ft, 100+ brands, with services such as makeovers and skin diagnostics).
Lower-capex formats (Kay Kafe, Nykaa Wanderlust Cart, Nykaa Kiosk) are being used to add footprint quickly.
Nykaa Now is live in 13 cities with over 1,000 brands and 60-minute delivery; the fulfilment cost per order is higher than mainline and is being monitored.
Superstore network covers 1,200+ cities, with 100 more cities added in the quarter.
Capital employed rose to INR 2,211 crore from INR 1,658 crore in Q1 FY24.
demand_pricing: Beauty visits reached about 0.5 billion in Q1 (+22% YoY); annual unique transacting customers crossed 20 million (20.8 million cited) out of about 60 million lifetime buyers.
Beauty orders grew close to 20% YoY; management said the QoQ order dip cited by an analyst (17.5 million to 17.3 million) reflects seasonality.
New launches included Rare Beauty (top-5 prestige brand within weeks), K18, SK-II and Anua. The brand count is 10,000+, with about 160 added in the quarter.

Fashion customer acquisition rose 44% YoY at a 30% lower CAC over two years. Nike D2C platform crossed 1.5 million app installs in under six months; Virtual Closet saw over 200,000 avatars created with more than 2x conversion.
Nykaa Now is priced the same as mainline, since brands fund discounts; the mix is beauty-led, with personal care subcategories growing incrementally.

qa_highlights.question: What is the economic arrangement with Nike, and how is customer data handled?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Nykaa runs Nike's D2C sites (Nike.in and the iOS/Android apps) end-to-end, including fulfilment, under a retailer-like arrangement with commission-style and service income and inventory protection. Financial terms were not disclosed; the marketplace listing is a standard arrangement.

qa_highlights.question: How will Nykaa Now's EBITDA drag trend as it expands to 25+ cities?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no margin dilution at current scale; purchase frequency is rising and AOV is consistent with mainline. Fulfilment cost per order is higher and is the cost being watched.

qa_highlights.question: When does Superstore GMV growth normalise toward the 40-45% CAGR ambition?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the GST effect normalises from Q3 FY27, after which NSV and GMV growth should converge. The stated target is a 35%+ CAGR reached by FY2030, driven by more retailers, wellness categories and data-led brand placement.

qa_highlights.question: What is driving the growth acceleration and how much is market versus company-specific?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited a strong market plus execution: penetration and premiumisation in Beauty, assortment and brand additions (1,200+ brands in a year) and new business lines in Fashion. Both businesses said they had grown faster than the industry.

qa_highlights.question: Are marketing efficiency gains structural and how much more is available?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said marketing spend is being held steady while acquisition is pushed, with repeat customers rising as a share of revenue. Fashion CAC is improving, with 44% more new customers acquired YoY.

qa_highlights.question: What is the medium-term TAM and can AUTC growth be sustained?
qa_highlights.answer: Management put the relevant online fashion TAM at 65-100 million consumers over five years and said there is no price filter for beauty. The growth lever is frequency and AOV on the 60 million lifetime buyers, not just new acquisition.

risks_watch: GST-led MRP impact on Superstore GMV and the gap between NSV and GMV growth until Q3 FY27.
Nykaa Now fulfilment costs as the network grows from 13 to 25+ cities.
Fashion growth depends partly on the Nike D2C partnership, which laps in mid-Q4 FY27; the underlying growth rate ex-Nike was not quantified.
Festive timing shift into Q3 FY27 could affect the Q2 and Q3 comparison base.
Aminu acquisition (INR 19 crore FY26 revenue) and the staged buyout of the remaining 49%.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth and margins, with management attributing gains to structural drivers. It was less specific on Nike economics, Fashion growth after Nike, and the Superstore GST effect, citing contract confidentiality and deferring to the Investor Day.
key_quotes: So what this slide highlights is how our philosophy of prudent capital utilization has enabled us to deliver an increasingly strong balance sheet.
We are pleased with the balance we have achieved between ambition and discipline, investing in customer acquisition and future capabilities while steadily expanding margins and returns.
So our early read is that we don't think this will be dilutive if at all.

adds.what: Nykaa Now quick-commerce expansion from 13 cities to over 25 cities
Nykaa Retail stores: 11 openings in Q1 (324 stores total), low-capex formats used to add footprint

growth.why: Management reiterated 35%+ Superstore GMV CAGR by FY2030 and 3-3.5x Fashion growth over 4-5 years, with Q1 net revenue up 29% and Beauty NSV up 29%; backing is partly specific (store openings, Nykaa Now city roll-out to 25+ by end FY27, 0.5m retailers, 18 new brands) but no explicit capacity or order-book numbers tie to the long-term targets.
